approval_transition.command_status: NOT READY: pending approval and input-inventory gate
approval_transition.requirements: Resolve the input-inventory blocker under explicit maintainer direction first. After execution approval, create a separate approved lock referencing this proposal hash and the actual reviewed source/environment; set execution_authorized=true and a nonempty real review identifier. If source changes, regenerate/review the entire lock; do not reuse this source fingerprint.

persistence.filename_rule: SHA256(UTF-8 task ID).json; input ID is input:PROBLEM_ID; worker transport is SHA256(task ID).worker.json
persistence.report_stdout_capture: Use a separately named immutable report JSON; do not overwrite prior reports or search checkpoints.
persistence.result_publication: exclusive attempt creation, hashed running record, fsync temporary result, atomic replacement
persistence.resume: Verify the full approved lock and sealed input inventory; skip existing completed, exception, interrupted/running and timed-out attempts; execute only never-attempted missing task IDs. Missing sealed inputs and unconfirmed cleanup stop.

preflight_blockers.observed: The runner stores individually hashed input checkpoints but creates no aggregate input inventory. Its run path calls store.execute for each input, regenerating a missing checkpoint, including on resume. The worker verifies an individual checkpoint payload only.
preflight_blockers.requirement: After all six inputs exist, seal their exact hashes in an immutable aggregate inventory and verify it before every task or resume; do not regenerate missing sealed inputs.
preflight_blockers.resolution: Maintainer review required; no source change, input generation or protocol relaxation performed. Existing runner command is not ready for approval alone.

preflight_warnings.detail: execution_authorized=false and maintainer_review=null intentionally reject execution; no authorization will be inferred from elapsed time or design approval.

Existing require_authorization checks fingerprint only (75 source hashes, canonical manifest, scope, Python/platform, NumPy/SciPy/toolkit versions and six thread variables). Commit/tree and supplementary installed-distribution/BLAS identity are recorded here but require explicit preflight verification at execution/resume.
Externally terminated workers retain the scheduled attempt and censored time; partial model/component work is unknown, never reported as zero.

Resolver condition dictionaries retain comprehensive defaults poisson_replicates=3; the pilot enumerator explicitly uses one Poisson replicate. Effective pilot task inventory is six problems, 18 tasks; no manifest or resolver field was edited.
v1 retains bounded_trf_deferred and audit implemented=false as historical planning labels; checkpoint documentation records implementation. Manifest is unchanged.
Pilot shares model/IRF definitions with comprehensive development. It is operational development evidence, not untouched qualification; no production default or scientific criterion is selected.

reporting.objective_gap: production minus audit; +/-0.01 descriptive agreement tolerance requires complete consistent audit; negative excess indicates audit search limitation; incomplete audits cannot establish agreement
quantities: model calls by phase and invocation
component convolutions and unknown failed work
conditional component recovery and contributor counts
reporting.runtime: Retain exact completed times and censored deadline contributors; report unavailable partial work honestly.
reporting.source_review: Read-only inspection of summarize_tasks/report_store/execute_task and DevelopmentStore; no report cross-scoring invoked.
reporting.target_kind: mean targets remain deterministic_expected_counts; Poisson targets are raw_counts

two_stage_input_integrity.current_runner_support: Individual payload/identity/lock verification exists; aggregate seal, per-task inventory verification and no-regeneration resume gate do not.
two_stage_input_integrity.input_hash_encoding: Raw checkpoint file SHA256; canonical payload SHA256; array bytes as contiguous little-endian float64 in C order, with shape/dtype/target-kind recorded.
two_stage_input_integrity.stage_1: Seal approved source/manifest/environment/settings/task inventory before creating any observation.
two_stage_input_integrity.stage_2: During separately authorized execution, generate and save all six inputs before launching the first fit or audit; seal exact file, payload, time-grid, observation and assumed-kernel hashes in input_inventory.json; verify inventory and input hashes before every task/resume. Missing/corrupt sealed inputs must stop, not regenerate.
